note: Written when the project was created, so these are the choices made for Frills, not an inherited stack. Say 'refresh pre-flight' to scan again.
fontStack: Plus Jakarta Sans (display and body) and JetBrains Mono (labels), self-hosted woff2 from Fontsource packages under the SIL Open Font License, declared in src/css/fonts.css. Chat-look fonts: Geist, Bricolage Grotesque, Space Grotesk, Fredoka, Baloo 2, Press Start 2P (public/fonts, licences in public/fonts/licenses).
palette: OKLCH custom properties in tokens.css: paper and ink, pear accent, sky, coral, mint, lavender. The overlay files (chat.css, looks.css, looks-matcha.css) use plain hex and rgba on purpose, because the browser inside OBS can be old.
motion: No animation library. Plain CSS keyframes and the Web Animations API, all behind prefers-reduced-motion.
framework: None. A static site built by build.mjs (esbuild plus a small template engine) and served as Cloudflare Workers static assets.
